name: Passkey Credential Owner Mismatch Rejected
summary: Rejects an assertion or attestation when the challenge, credential owner, and selected durable identity do not match.

preconditions.expression: challenge is valid but credential or challenge user differs from the selected durable identity

setup: Create credentials for two distinct durable users.

inputs.description: Assertion from a credential owned by another user.

sourceReferences.note: challenge_user_mismatch, credential_user_mismatch, and user-handle ownership checks
